### Workout playback improvements

- Preview the next exercise, set, reps, and weight during rest so you can prepare equipment.
- Add optional performance notes after each exercise, then review and copy a completion summary. Notes and summaries are not stored as workout history.
- Optionally keep the screen awake during workouts.
- Enable a gentle rest-complete chime when the countdown reaches zero. Playback still waits for Next.
- Optionally keep the exercise header and image visible while scrolling through guidance. Limited screen space falls back to normal page scrolling.

Playback preferences are remembered. Keep screen on defaults to enabled; rest-complete sound and the fixed-image layout default to disabled. Wake lock and sound depend on browser and device support; the chime is not a background or lock-screen alarm.

### Deployment and upgrades

- Deploy using the self-contained source package or the AMD64/ARM64 GHCR image. Runtime assets remain embedded; generation tooling is not required.
- Before upgrading, stop the application and back up its persistent `/data` directory (the `workout-data` volume in the default Compose setup).
- Keep the existing data volume when replacing the container. Database migrations apply automatically at startup and preserve existing workouts and settings.
- To roll back to v0.1.0, restore the pre-upgrade data backup along with the older application version; do not assume database downgrades are supported.

The app remains single-user, network-dependent, and restricted to origin-root hosting. Deploy only on a trusted network or behind external access controls. Active workouts cannot be resumed after closing the page.
